verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions API keys, a secrets store, credential separation, or redaction. The dotenv documentation describes environment variables that shape application behavior, such as model availability and social logins. It does not say provider credentials are kept out of chat or that any redaction happens, so it is only adjacent configuration tooling and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, credentials are handled deliberately — a secrets store or env separation with redaction, never API keys pasted into chat history
